Stop Energy Loss With Expert Duct Sealing

The U.S. Department of Energy estimates that up to 30% of conditioned air is lost through leaky ducts. This means your HVAC system is working harder than it needs to — and you're paying for air that never reaches your rooms.


HD Pro Cleaning provides professional duct sealing services that locate and permanently seal every leak in your duct system. We use mastic sealant and foil tape — industry-approved materials built to last — to restore your system's full efficiency.

Our Duct Sealing Work

Pressure Leak Testing

We pressurize your duct system to accurately locate every leak before sealing begins.

Mastic Sealant Application

Industry-standard mastic sealant is applied to all joints and seams for a durable, airtight seal.

Foil Tape Sealing

UL-listed foil tape reinforces connections and seals minor gaps throughout the duct system.

Return Air Sealing

Return air ducts are often the biggest source of leaks — we seal them thoroughly.

Attic & Crawl Space Ducts

Ducts in unconditioned spaces are sealed and re-insulated to prevent major energy loss.

Post-Seal Verification

Airflow is re-tested after sealing to confirm the system is operating at peak efficiency.

Our Air Duct Sealing Process

A precise, test-driven approach to eliminating air leaks

🔍

Inspection

We inspect your full duct system and identify all areas of air loss.

Benefits of Professional Duct Sealing

Lower Energy Bills

Sealed ducts can cut HVAC energy waste by up to 30%, reducing monthly utility costs.

Even Temperatures

Every room gets its full share of conditioned air — no more hot or cold spots.

Better Air Quality

Sealed ducts prevent dust, allergens, and garage fumes from entering your air supply.

Less HVAC Wear

Your system doesn't have to work as hard, reducing wear and extending equipment life.

Reduced Humidity

Proper sealing helps control moisture levels and prevent mold growth inside ducts.

Quick ROI

Most homeowners recoup duct sealing costs through energy savings within 1 to 2 years.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I know if my ducts are leaking?

High energy bills, uneven room temperatures, and excessive dust are common signs of duct leakage.

How long does duct sealing take?

Most residential duct sealing jobs are completed in a single day.

Is duct sealing worth it?

Yes. Homes with leaky ducts can save 20–30% on energy costs after professional sealing.

Do you use Aeroseal?

We use manual mastic and foil tape sealing. Contact us to ask about Aeroseal availability in your area.
